title: Security fix for GHSA-r68h-jhhj-9jvm applied in: wso2am 4.4.0-r2
description: A security vulnerability was identified in the wso2am package affecting versions prior to 4.4.0-r2. The issue has been resolved in version 4.4.0-r2. No specific details about the nature or impact of the vulnerability are provided in the available data.
